title: Ship-To Service Levels: Entry Gates, Setup Time and Inactivity Terms
content:
The Ship-To Fulfillment Account is held at one of six service levels, ranked here from lowest to highest. Each level has an entry gate measured on trailing 12 month ship-to spend, and the three route levels also require the delivery location to be inside a Corbett branch route territory.

| Rank | Service level | Entry gate: minimum trailing 12 month ship-to spend (USD) | Delivery ZIP must be inside a route territory | Setup (business days to validate and open a new ship-to) | Inactivity suspension (whole months without any booked order) | Downgrade spend percent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Corbett Parcel Ship-To | 0 | no | 2 | 12 | 0 |
| 2 | Corbett Standard Ship-To | 5,000 | no | 2 | 12 | 60 |
| 3 | Corbett Priority Ship-To | 25,000 | no | 2 | 12 | 60 |
| 4 | Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To | 60,000 | yes | 5 | 12 | 70 |
| 5 | Corbett Premier Route Ship-To | 150,000 | yes | 5 | 18 | 70 |
| 6 | Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To | 500,000 | yes | 10 | 24 | 80 |

**Column definitions**

- *Setup* — the business days to validate and open a new ship-to.
- *Inactivity suspension* — the whole months without any booked order after which an active ship-to is suspended.
- *Downgrade spend percent* — at the ship-to's annual review, trailing 12 month spend below this percent of the tier's entry gate spend moves it down one tier; 0 means never.

**Points of reading**

- The route levels are Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To and Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To; a delivery ZIP outside every route territory can hold only one of the three lower levels.
- Corbett Parcel Ship-To has no spend gate and a downgrade spend percent of 0.
- A Corbett Premier Route Ship-To is suspended after 18 whole months without a booked order and a Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To after 24; every other level after 12.
